label: Generic acquisition
target: B2B and SaaS companies of any size or stage, including specialized business software, seeking more predictable customer acquisition and evidence-based growth rather than volume-based activity.
basis: The defining target contains only generic categories; acquisition is an intent clause.

label: Channel networks
target: Mid-market B2B companies with growing channel partner networks (50-500 partners) focused on rapid scaling and co-selling initiatives.
basis: Channel partner networks name a programme.

label: Seed SaaS
target: Seed to Series A B2B SaaS companies with a launched product.
basis: Funding stage and launched product do not name an industry, buyer function or technology.

label: Generic brands with acquisition intent
target: Global Brands and Advertisers seeking to scale their marketing efforts through affiliate partnerships.
basis: The defining target is generic brands and advertisers; affiliate marketing occurs in the intent clause.

label: Buyer function
target: Sales and Marketing Operations teams within technology companies focused on optimizing their Go-To-Market (GTM) processes and revenue generation.
basis: Sales and marketing operations name a buyer function.

label: Channel programme
target: Companies managing and scaling channel partner programs, from emerging to enterprise levels, that require tools to manage partner onboarding, co-selling, co-marketing, and performance tracking.
basis: Channel partner programmes name a programme.
